text:
Diego: Quick check-in 1. We need a single sign-off doc for GA that covers: SLA tiers + exact numeric SLOs, what we surface in Console, monitoring alert thresholds, and any pricing footnotes (burst vs reserved). Can owners for each area call out now?
Hannah: I'll own the monitoring side. Proposal: 95th latency per-route + error-rate per-route. Alerts: page if 95th > target for 2 consecutive 3m windows OR error_rate > 0.75% for 10m. Will link runbook.
Sam: I'll own SLA wording. Draft language: "Silver: 95th percentile latency <= 120ms; Gold: 95th <= 80ms AND 99th <= 200ms". Recommend we mark Gold as "Dedicated or Reserved" only. Need legal to review force majeure/backfill wording. :writing_hand:
Priya: Docs owner here. I'll create a "How to interpret your SLA" card and an example invoice snippet. Also we should have an FAQ line: "What happens during a partial regional outage?" with fallback explanation.
Maya: Product decision: expose per-route 95th and error % in Console for Silver+ customers by GA. For Bronze keep aggregate metrics. Priya add screenshots mockups.
Aj: Engineering notes: per-route telemetry for private installs will be behind a feature flag (privacy/perf tradeoff). I'll open the PR. Also we'll need an opt-out clause for teams that disable route-level telemetry.
Hannah: Monitoring details I'm adding to the runbook: synthetic ping every 5m per-region and a canary traffic job that exercises common model paths. Alert rule example (PromQL-style):

alert: SLA_latency_page
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{env=~"prod.*"}[5m])) by (le, route)) > ROUTE_THRESHOLD
for: 6m

Include a muted window for known deploys.
Sam: SLA escalation: for verified breaches we credit usage for the impacted window. Need finance sign-off on credit formulas (percent of monthly invoice based on % of failing tokens). Frank from billing please chime in.
billing-bot: Billing note: reserved capacity customers receive a 10% unit discount and are eligible for throughput guarantees. Burst (hosted) customers: best-effort; overage billed at published overage rate. If sustained >10% above quota for 24h we may throttle. See billing page https://billing.redwood/overage
Priya: Docs decision: include sample wording for billing footnote and a short matrix: Reserved vs Burst vs Private. I'll add a "Known limitations" box for burst.
Maya: One more operational callout: auto-fallback option when model errors spike. We'll implement a toggle: fallback_to_variant=true which routes to a quantized/safer variant. Aj can we make that configurable per-customer?
Aj: Yes. We'll expose it as a per-deployment policy with default off. Implementation ETA: PR in 48h, e2e test in 72h.
Diego: Action list (owners + ETA): Hannah -> runbook + alert rules (24h). Sam -> SLA legal wording + credit formula draft (48h). Priya -> Console screenshots + docs (48h). Aj -> telemetry PR + fallback policy (48h). Finance/Billing -> confirm credit calc (48h).
Maya: We also need a pre-GA smoke: run the canary traffic for 72h and verify <threshold violations. Schedule?
Hannah: Can run canary starting 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC for 72h. I'll post results to this thread.
Maya: Perfect. If anyone can't meet their ETA, please flag now. Otherwise I'll assemble and send the consolidated sign-off doc tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
